title: Budget in Parliament
quote: The word "budget" is not used in the Constitution - it is the Annual Financial Statement (Art. 112)

boxes.title: Budget basics
items: Financial year **1 April - 31 March**; laid before **both Houses**
Prepared by **Budget Division, DEA**; starts with **Budget Circular**
First Union budget: **26 Nov 1947**, **R.K. Shanmukham Chetty**

boxes.title: Budget Articles in order
steps: ==**114**: Appropriation Bill== (no withdrawal from CFI without law)

boxes.title: Charged on CFI (non-votable)
items: Presiding officers of both Houses; **SC judges**
Can be **discussed**, not voted; ensures independence

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Contingency Fund: ==**₹30,000 crore**== from FY **2021-22** (earlier **₹500 crore**)
Appropriation Bill: no amendment to vary amount; auto repeal (APPSC-G1 2024)
Cannot withdraw from CFI on own: President, PM, FM, **CAG**
Passed cut motion → govt must resign
